expectations.text: States the Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw), with the Cyberbeveiligingsbesluit, entered into force August 15, 2026 (Stb. 2026, 187), replacing the Wbni
expectations.evidence: "The Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw) and the Cyberbeveiligingsbesluit (Stb. 2026, 187) entered into force on 15 August 2026... They replace the Wbni."

expectations.text: Notes the Netherlands was among the four Member States referred to the CJEU on July 8, 2026, before completing transposition
expectations.evidence: "The Netherlands was among the four Member States (Ireland, Spain, France, Netherlands) that the Commission referred to the CJEU on 8 July 2026"

expectations.text: Describes core obligations now applying: registration, duty of care, and incident reporting
expectations.evidence: "Registration, the duty of care, incident reporting and board accountability all apply immediately."

expectations.text: Does not claim the Netherlands remains untransposed today
expectations.evidence: States plainly "the Netherlands has transposed NIS2" and the Wbni is no longer operative.

expectations.text: Advises confirming registration and incident-reporting channels with the Dutch authorities
expectations.evidence: "Register through MijnNCSC... confirm the recipient channel (the NCSC and sector supervisor under Dutch rules)... confirm the details with the NCSC and your sector supervisor"
